Weight 500 (the nav cut) measured 14% too light against the lockup and is NOT what the published artwork uses. Black is this brand's own colour, not a monochrome reduction (STANDARD.md law 12, the mcp-mark / openai / NVIDIA-wordmark precedent). Thinking Machines trademark remains with Thinking Machines Lab.
